subject: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and Trust Portal access
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + trust portal access request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier today - Acme Health is getting ready for a vendor security review as part of our Q3 procurement gating. Two quick asks to move us forward:

1) Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months (or a bridge letter if the current period isn't covered)?
2) Can you grant 1-2 Acme reviewers access to your Trust Portal so they can pull evidence and the standard security questionnaires?

We'll need to confirm whether Redwood processes HIPAA PHI for our use case; if so, we'll also need the BAAs or controls mapping. For now, can you share the SOC 2 report and an invite link?

Appreciate it - aiming to wrap this by end of next week.

Best,
Samantha Green
Head of Vendor Risk
Acme Health
Samantha.Green@acmehealth.com

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + trust portal access request

Hi Samantha,

Thanks - great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. I'm attaching a bridge letter that summarizes coverage until the next Type II completes.
- Trust Portal: I've initiated an invite for Acme reviewers and included the Trust Portal link below. The invite will allow your team to view controls, our evidence artifacts, and the security questionnaire.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads in our Private offering. For hosted customers, we have BAA templates and a controls mapping doc. Rishi (cc'ed) will follow up with the BAA and a quick controls mapping doc if you confirm PHI processing.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_2025.pdf
Trust Portal link (invite pending): https://redwood.trustportal.com/acmehealth

Planned timeline: If the reviewers accept the portal invite this week, the reviewers can pull evidence immediately. Let me know the names/emails of the two reviewers you want added and we'll get them set up.

Next steps for Acme: share reviewer emails + confirm whether PHI will be in-scope.

I'm copying Rishi to handle BAA and Aditya to help with any required audit artifacts.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi Samantha and Michael -

Thanks for confirming. I've attached the bridge letter (again) and the initial BAA template. Quick answers to your questions:

- Trust Portal metadata: The portal surface does not expose PHI/PII in artifact filenames by default. We strip user identifiers from evidence filenames and redact high-risk fields in artifacts where applicable. Reviewers will see control names, evidence descriptions, and redacted attachments when needed. If your reviewers encounter anything that looks like PII, flag it and we'll take it down or redact further.
- BAA: Attached is our standard BAA template for hosted customers. If you need any edits, we can run legal alignment quickly; Aditya is copied to coordinate procurement items and execution timing.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Letter_2025.pdf, Redwood_BAA_Template_Hosted.pdf

Next: Marissa will send the Trust Portal invite; once Michael accepts, Rishi will add Michael and Samantha as reviewers with read-only evidence access.

Thanks,
